description: The data of an entry event: one new entry of a feed.

feed.description: The address of the feed. It is also the room id.

entry_id.description: The id of the entry in the feed: the guid or id, else the link.

published.description: The publish or update time of the entry, as RFC 3339.

summary.description: The summary or the content of the entry as plain text, at most 2000 bytes.
